message:
Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill. Do NOT create files: Ripple builds the .ics and .csv itself.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

raw:
I can't finish the update yet because scenario B conflicts with the disruption detail, and I don't want to guess the new time or room for the workshop. I've sent a clarifying question with three options:

1. **Swap:** another session takes the 10:00–11:00 slot in room B. I need to know which session it is, its speaker, and its room.
2. **Delay:** the workshop moves to 12:00–13:00. I need the room, since the smaller amphitheatre at Maison de la Chimie is still "to confirm".
3. **Hold:** no messages go out until the swap session and room are confirmed.

Once you choose, I'll return the `{"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]}` object with:
- A draft message to Speaker 2 (speaker2@example.com) and one to the workshop participants (40 workshop participants, since no single address applies).
- `revised_schedule` containing only the items whose time or place changes.
- As requested, no `.ics` or `.csv` files will be created. Ripple will build those itself.

If it is the delay, should workshop_s2 be moved to 12:00-13:00 and in which room (the smaller amphitheatre at Maison de la Chimie is listed as 'to confirm')?
